title: Mirror chamber
description: A folded white motif reflects into a changing peacock-blue radial composition.
useCase: Generate symmetry from a single authored motif with an editable reflection count.
reducedMotion: The elapsed-time clock stops. Parameter controls immediately update the static composition.
limitations: Requires WebGL 1; a static CSS swatch appears if unavailable or after context loss. Reflects included procedural geometry only; no external image or arbitrary page sampling.
look: Flat peacock-blue field with six cream petal shapes, each with a leaf-shaped cut-out, ringed around a thin orange star outline and orange dot.
motion: Mirrored wedges rotate slowly while the motif turns inside them, producing a continuously shifting kaleidoscope; the Reflections slider steps between 3 and 10 sectors.
adapt: The fold lives in `FRAGMENT`: `sectors` (from `u_control`) sets the wedge count, `u_time*.04` spins the fold and `rot(.5+u_time*.055)` turns the motif. Redraw the motif masks and swap `blue`, `white` and `orange`; keep the fallback and reduced-motion branch.
